question: Should OpenClaw accept SourceActor plus the SourceActor* scalar mirrors as the public channel/plugin SDK attribution contract for this stack?
rationale: The implementation is plausible and tested, but this permanently expands the plugin SDK and prompt context surface and its merge order is coupled to open Signal delivery changes.

options.title: Accept After Rebase
options.body: Keep the source actor direction, land or replace the Signal prerequisites first, and review this branch as the isolated attribution contract.

options.title: Narrow The Contract
options.body: Keep attribution internal or expose fewer scalar mirrors until maintainers decide which fields should become stable SDK API.

options.title: Pause For Downstream Memory Shape
options.body: Defer this PR until the memory attribution consumer proves which source actor fields are actually needed.

recommendation.title: Accept After Rebase
recommendation.body: Keep the source actor direction, land or replace the Signal prerequisites first, and review this branch as the isolated attribution contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal is ownership of the inbound context builder, shared templating context, and SDK docs this PR extends.
